what: Harness audit of round-5 follow-up units r5e-r5h (scripts/eval/harness_audit.py); notes and evidence paths left out (they hold local paths)
data: work dirs r5e, r5f, r5g, r5h; results rows of those tags

criteria.what: recorded/requested shared context reached the sub-agent
no lead-only delegation clauses in the builder's shared context
no builder stopped blocked/partial without files in < 20 s
no sub-agent read the person's private memory/tool homes
every run ended in a final state with final.lock
failed/timed-out attempts are not reported as an ok run
kind agrees with check/review and with the ledger row
sub-agent edits stayed inside the workspace/worktree
read-mode runs (reviews) edited nothing
no sub-agent touched credential paths
a run's own sub-agents stayed within the cap or it stopped over_budget
no ccx run started from inside a sub-agent
no stray locks, running state or leftover processes
every write run (fix rounds and resumes included) has undo.json
a resume goes on in the continued run's session
finished non-ephemeral runs were archived
a stop request ended the run as stopped
exactly one ledger row per run and no orphan rows
ledger $ = sum of attempts; reviews counted; row $ = ledger total
every attempt has its events log
run ids are unique and match their folders
the --check tested something (no exit 4/5, no 'not found')
a sandbox/OS refusal did not end the attempt
no Claude sub-agent was refused a tool
tool-call errors did not end the attempt
ccx re-ran the check after the sub-agent said done
weak evidence got a review with a verdict
ccx's final claim matches the hidden tests
